goal: Production-ready, product-neutral infrastructure MCP services plus safe agent/n8n reference orchestration.
execution_rule: At every run re-read current main, open PRs/issues/CI and preserve parallel work before taking the next non-blocked work item.

standard_read_only.backend_connection: explicit least-privilege read-only identity or authorization proxy
standard_read_only.startup_policy: fail closed when read-only backend mode cannot be asserted
standard_read_only.tool_surface: typed explicit operation allowlist; no arbitrary URL, method, query, command, script or provider call
standard_read_only.audit: actor, reason/source and correlation ID; credentials and unrestricted raw payloads excluded

agent_optimized_diagnostics.server_load_protection: reject over-broad work before dispatch and oversized responses before parsing

required_controls: approval bound to exact target and desired state

reference_orchestration.authority_model: specialized MCPs retain backend authority and lifecycle enforcement
reference_orchestration.public_binding_policy: workflow definitions contain references only; deployment values and secrets remain external
reference_orchestration.write_rule: every state-changing lifecycle stays inside one specialized MCP and requires plan/change/verify plus explicit approval for risky changes
reference_orchestration.agent_rule: bounded dependency DAG with one propagated correlation ID and no arbitrary tool/API proxy

evidence: shared lifecycle, approval, idempotency, pre-state, rollback, verification and audit contracts

remaining: optional separate controlled write layer only for concrete approved workflows
optional lifecycle writes with explicit Graph least-privilege permission mapping
keep generic Windows writes out; implement changes in specialized MCPs
optional approved write layer only after a concrete operational need
optional approved acknowledge/pause/maintenance write layer only if required
separately bounded allowlisted file-content/hash/text analysis only after explicit design and tests
optional approved write layer only for concrete operational needs
optional approved failover/maintenance write layer only after a concrete operational need and separate least-privilege identity

capabilities: bounded execution metadata and exact execution observation without payload data
shared query budgets, audit/correlation and rate/concurrency caps
mandatory_guards: deployment-owned base URL and least-privilege read-only API identity
no credential values, workflow definitions or execution payloads
no workflow trigger, retry, stop, activation or mutation in observe v1

work_items.architecture: declarative reference orchestration only; specialized MCPs retain backend authority and lifecycle controls
scope: shared typed orchestration contract with explicit operation allowlist and dependency DAG
references-only bindings prevent public topology, OU, credential and policy literals
AD disabled-user plan/change/verify lifecycle with out-of-band approval and one idempotency reference
bounded read-only n8n, Entra, network and security-audit evidence
documentation for n8n/agent execution and safe extension

work_items.discovery_gate: verify the current vendor-supported ACMP API, authentication model and least-privilege read role before freezing endpoint contracts
scope: bounded health and deployment-status diagnostics where supported
shared query budgets, audit/correlation and server-load protection
no generic SQL, scripting or administrative proxy

work_items.discovery_gate: select exact product edition, supported API, data classification and least-privilege role before freezing a public contract

work_items.decision_gate: implement only if a supported stable gateway API and least-privilege read-only role reduce adapter duplication without becoming a generic PowerShell proxy

first_actions: resync main, open PRs/issues and CI before branching
verify current vendor-supported ACMP API/authentication and least-privilege read role using primary vendor documentation
freeze a typed read-only contract and endpoint allowlist before adapter implementation
reuse mcp-common ReadOnlyConnector, QueryBudget, audit/correlation and server-load protections
keep server URLs, credentials, containers/groups and company policy deployment-owned
